title: Giants driven out by Joshua settle on Sardinia

tellings.quote: I think that Joshua drove out a lot of the giants that weren't killed in the conquest.

plain: The filmmaker Tim Alberino believes that the giants of the Bible who survived Joshua's conquest of Canaan were driven out and settled on the Mediterranean island of Sardinia: "Joshua drove out a lot of the giants that weren't killed in the conquest," he tells Michels. He builds this on his own reading of the King James Bible, published in 1611, offering it as a way to explain giant traces far from the Holy Land.
